B_ADD_UINT8_REQUANT.description: The audited Add-Dequant template ends in FP32 and does not consume output qparams.

B_CONV_BIAS_PSUM.description: Bias and first/middle/last-K INT32 psum lifecycle are not bound to official fields.

B_CONV_INT8_SA.description: No official INT8 SA Conv template and accumulator contract is available.

B_DEQUANT_STANDALONE.description: No audited standalone one-input UINT8-to-FP32 Dequantize configuration exists.

B_EXECPLAN_TYPED_TRANSPORT.description: The official OperatorSpec and handlers do not transport typed qparams/constants.

B_GAP_CENTERED_SUM.description: The static AvgPool sum template does not prove subtraction of input zero point.

B_GAP_DIV_REQUANT.description: Division by the spatial count and UINT8 requant are absent from the audited template.

B_LAYOUT_APPROVAL.description: RTL28 physical port layout remains candidate rather than hardware-approved.

B_MATMUL_INT8_SA.description: All audited SA GEMM/GEMV templates are FP16 rather than INT8/INT32.

B_MATMUL_PSUM.description: Persistent INT32 psum and SA-to-GA requant boundaries are unbound.

B_MATMUL_TAIL.description: M=16 and N=1000 tail rules are absent and current floor division omits work.

B_MAXPOOL_SHAPE_GENERALIZATION.description: C4 shape-to-LC rules cover audited samples but are not approved as a general generator.

B_MAXPOOL_UINT8_SEMANTICS.description: Signed int8_max behavior has not been proven equivalent to UINT8 MaxPool.

B_QUANT_FP32_INPUT_PATH.description: The audited quant template consumes INT32, not ONNX QuantizeLinear FP32 input.

B_QUANT_ROUNDING_EXECUTION.description: Nearest-even and saturation were inferred but not executed by an approved target model.

B_REQUANT_TARGET_NUMERICS.description: INT32-to-UINT8 requant rounding, saturation and target execution are not closed.

B_SUM_COMPLETION.description: Static full-event wiring does not establish the hardware completion protocol.

B_SUM_CROSS_SLICE.description: Remote-sum names do not prove N2N/neighbor transport or cross-slice reduction.
